summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored Irish documents on the Immigrant Investor Programme: Dail written answers 2012-2026 (Oireachtas XML, whole day of answers; only the IIP questions are in scope), the October 2022 guidelines and three Immigration Service Delivery web pages (closure FAQ, external review, wind-down). Every cell of the statistics tables (by year, route, nationality, application window, Russian and Chinese applicants, unit staff) not already in the data was added; all printed totals were checked.
